description: This file contains the definition of the ITransactionalResource interface, which specifies the contract for components participating in distributed transactions within the Orleans framework. It includes method signatures for transaction commit, prepare, abort, cancel, and confirm actions, along with associated parameters and internal documentation.

classes.name: ITransactionalResource
classes.description: Interface exposing transaction participant operations such as commit, prepare, abort, cancel, and confirm, used by Orleans transaction system.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Handles read-only transaction commit requests, responding with the transaction status.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a participant for a transaction, signaling readiness or other pre-commit actions.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Informs a participant to abort the given transaction.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Informs a participant that a transaction has been aborted, providing a timestamp and reason.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Signals to a participant that a transaction has committed, prompting cleanup.
